project.name: CalcAMS
project.description: A web application to calculate safety corridors and Area Minimum Altitude (AMS) for GPX, KML, and TXT routes.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Exclusion pattern list specifying files and directories to ignore during codebase analysis.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: Core client-side JavaScript file implementing Leaflet maps, Turf.js calculations, GPX/KML parsing, and AMS corridor processing.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML user interface definition with sidebar panel, theme toggle, GPX/KML/TXT upload button, and Leaflet map container.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Vibrant custom styling system supporting dark, light, and system themes with glassmorphism sidebar panels.

nodes.name: applyTheme
nodes.summary: Applies the chosen color theme (light, dark, or system auto) and updates the map tile source URLs.

nodes.name: handleFileUpload
nodes.summary: Handles route file uploads, determines format (GPX, KML, TXT), parses XML or plain text, and kicks off coordinates extraction.

nodes.name: loadTileImage
nodes.summary: Asynchronously loads a map tile image and draws it to a canvas to inspect image data for elevation values.

nodes.name: extractCoordinates
nodes.summary: Extracts coordinates from GeoJSON feature collections, computing distances and densifying points along track/route lines.

nodes.name: parseRouteFile
nodes.summary: Parses TXT route files containing structured waypoint data, names, and custom properties.

nodes.name: saveObject
nodes.summary: Saves a parsed waypoint or leg object into corresponding arrays during TXT route parsing.

nodes.name: processTxtRoute
nodes.summary: Processes parsed TXT route data, rendering waypoints on the map and triggering leg calculation.

nodes.name: processRouteCoordinates
nodes.summary: Core calculation engine that buffers the route, downloads tiles, queries elevations, computes AMS, and builds the legs table.

nodes.name: formatGGMM
nodes.summary: Formats decimal latitude and longitude into degrees and decimal minutes (GGMM) format for aviation navigation.

nodes.name: throttle
nodes.summary: Generic throttle utility function to rate-limit execution of rapid event handlers.

tour.title: Application Interface & Structure
tour.description: Start with index.html, which defines the core structure of the CalcAMS user interface. It mounts a Leaflet map container and provides a floating glassmorphic sidebar for uploading flight route files (GPX, KML, or TXT) and displaying computed leg safety data.

tour.title: Glassmorphism UI & Theme Styling
tour.description: Explore style.css, which implements a modern, premium design system featuring glassmorphic panels, harmonious color palettes, and full support for light, dark, and system auto themes. It delivers fluid responsiveness and rich aesthetics for the map-oriented layout.

tour.title: JavaScript Engine Overview & Theme Control
tour.description: Learn about the runtime architecture of CalcAMS in app.js. It coordinates geospatial libraries like Leaflet and Turf.js, handles user interaction, and implements dynamic theme changes.
tour.languageLesson: Using standard browser matchMedia queries enables automatic system theme changes inside client-side JavaScript.

tour.title: Route Upload and File Parsing
tour.description: Examine how flight route documents are processed. When a GPX, KML, or TXT file is uploaded, the engine reads and parses it to extract geographic coordinates and waypoints representing flight leg segments.

tour.title: Safety Corridor & AMS Calculation
tour.description: Deep dive into the core calculation engine of the application. It creates a Turf.js buffer around the route to define the safety corridor, queries elevation tile images, calculates the Area Minimum Altitude (AMS), and dynamically populates the results sidebar.
tour.languageLesson: Turf.js makes it easy to compute geospatial features like bounding boxes and coordinate buffers directly in the browser.
